description: Change when a document auto-deletes. The new expiry must be a FUTURE date (ISO 8601) at most 1 year out; set a nearer date to have it removed sooner. Requires admin access. If the document is in this MCP server's local store, 'key' is optional. There is no separate delete tool — bringing the expiry forward is how you remove a document early.

expires_at.description: New expiry as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z). Must be in the future and within 1 year from now.

key.description: Admin key. Optional if the document is in this MCP server's local store.

name: set_expiry
